ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Virtual Network Modified or Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a Virtual Network is modified or deleted in Azure. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: ((operationName = RGX("^MICROSOFT\\\.NETWORK\\/VIRTUALNETWORKGATEWAYS\\/") OR operationName = RGX("^MICROSOFT\\\.NETWORK\\/VIRTUALNETWORKS\\/")) AND (operationName = RGX("\\/WRITE$") OR operationName = RGX("\\/DELETE$")))
